 Harris County District Court
 Cause No. 2024-CV-0041
 Samantha Fowler, Plaintiff, v. Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance, Defendant
 Defendant's Original Answer
Date:
12-24-24
Counsel for defendant:
Stephanie Williams, Ashford & Lyle LLP
Defendant generally denies each and every allegation contained in Plaintiff's Original Petition and demands strict
proof thereof by a preponderance of the evidence, as required by the Texas Rules of Civil Procedure.
Subject to and without waiving the foregoing general denial, Defendant asserts the following affirmative defenses.
First, Plaintiff's alleged injuries and damages were not proximately caused by any negligence of Defendant. The
collision at issue may have resulted from the acts or omissions of Plaintiff, including following too closely and failing to
keep a proper lookout, and Plaintiff's own conduct therefore bars or reduces recovery under the proportionate
responsibility provisions of Chapter 33 of the Texas Civil Practice and Remedies Code.
Second, Defendant invokes the doctrine of sudden emergency. Any sudden and unexpected change in traffic
conditions immediately before impact left Defendant no reasonable time to react, and Defendant acted as a
reasonably prudent person would under the same circumstances.
Third, Plaintiff failed to mitigate damages. To the extent Plaintiff did not obtain reasonable and necessary medical
care, or unreasonably delayed or declined recommended treatment, any recovery must be reduced by the amount
that reasonable mitigation would have avoided.
</page>

"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.

address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
